subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Dodge Brothers
description: A fast breakdown of The Dodge Brothers for builders.

hook.text: John and Horace Dodge built parts for Ford before deciding they could build a better car themselves.

buildup.text: They supplied Ford with engines and axles—without the Dodges, the Model T couldn't have existed.

discovery.text: In 1914, they launched their own car. It was tougher and more powerful than the Model T.

twist.text: Both brothers died within a year of each other in 1920, cutting short a promising rivalry.

climax.text: Their company changed hands many times and eventually became part of Chrysler, then Stellantis.

punchline.text: Ford's best suppliers became his fiercest competitors.

quiz.question: What did the Dodge brothers supply to Ford?
